run_remove_lvis_rare_default: run the script to remove rare annotations from the default LVIS v1 train JSON dataset
run_remove_lvis_rare_custom_ann: run the script with a custom --ann path to filter rare annotations from any LVIS annotation file
build_filter_lvis_annotations: build a python module to filter out rare category annotations from an LVIS JSON dataset file
build_lvis_norare_generator: build a python module that generates a norare version of an LVIS annotation JSON by excluding rare categories
review_remove_lvis_rare_script: review the python module that loads LVIS annotations and filters out rare frequency categories
